counterfactual_actions.label: Isolate Compromised Host (WS-101)
counterfactual_actions.description: Sever all internal east-west traffic from Workstation 101 via host firewall and 802.1X VLAN quarantine.

counterfactual_actions.label: Block Internal SMB (Port 445)
counterfactual_actions.description: Enforce immediate ACL block on TCP port 445 between Workstation VLAN (10.0.2.0/24) and Core Servers (10.0.3.0/24).

counterfactual_actions.label: Drop External Attacker IP
counterfactual_actions.description: BGP Blackhole and Edge Firewall Drop of adversary ingress IP at perimeter border routers.

counterfactual_actions.label: Strict DMZ Micro-Segmentation
counterfactual_actions.description: Enforce zero-trust ingress gateway between DMZ cluster and internal user workstation subnets.
